values: 一名看起来不太正经的坦克，会在战斗中使用拿手的变形术保护队友。
A strange Tank who protects allies in battle with his signature transfiguration magic.
教训一下这群不懂敬畏魔法的家伙吧！
They'll fear magic the hard way!
Now, let's try fighting my way!
出发吧，要学的东西还有很多。
Come along! There is much knowledge yet to master.
Hm? Don't worry, it's just me.
Ah... that clears things up nicely.
谢谢，我很喜欢，就像喜欢故乡的热风与篝火。
Thank you. This stirs a fondness in me... like the warm fires of my homeland.
感谢你的心意，祝你的学业一切顺利。
How thoughtful. May your studies flourish as splendidly as your manners.
变成枭熊的话，沙发会坐不下吧……
If I turned into an owlbear, I probably wouldn't fit on the sofa...
I'd like something hot to drink.
蛮血大多都选择战士之路，但赫普却成为了一名魔法师。为了寻求魔法的进一步突破，他毅然离开温暖的家乡，来到了魔法学习氛围浓厚的耀光帝国。

Most Maulers become warriors. Hepler, however, chose to become a mage. In pursuit of greater magical mastery, he left his warm homeland and traveled to the Lightbearer Empire, a place renowned for its rich magical tradition.
来到耀光后，赫普进步最快的魔法就是变形术——他曾无数次变成枭熊取暖，变形术水平因此突飞猛进，到现在已经堪称大师级别。

After arriving in the empire, Hepler became adept in transfiguration. He often transformed into an owlbear just to stay warm, and with so much practice, his shapeshifting advanced at an astonishing pace.
刚到耀光时，赫普遇到最大的困难是适应这里的饮食习惯——他们实在往饭菜里放了太多“不必要”的蔬菜了。

When he first arrived, his greatest struggle was adjusting to the local cuisine. For reasons he still cannot understand, people there insist on adding far too many unnecessary vegetables to their meals.
赫普曾以为佐尔娅的石像鬼形态是变形术变成的，为此他以枭熊形态在课堂外等待她下课，打算向她请教一番，结果吓到了不少对变形术不够了解的预科班学生。
Hepler once mistook Zorya's gargoyle form for transfiguration. Waiting outside her classroom as an owlbear to ask about it, he ended up frightening several preparatory students.
在莱希拉姆就职的这些年，赫普深度测评了附近的每一家肉食店，成为了老板们最爱的客户。如果想知道学校附近实惠好吃的烤肉店，就去问问他吧。

During his years teaching at the Lyceum, Hepler has personally evaluated every meat restaurant near the academy. Local shop owners adore him. If you want to find a great barbecue place near campus, he's the one to ask.
赫普难以适应寒冷的环境。在某个冬日，课堂的恒温调控魔法失灵，赫普被冻得一句话也说不出来，只好全程以枭熊形态完成了授课。
Hepler struggles terribly with the cold. One winter day, the classroom's temperature-control spell malfunctioned. Too frozen to speak, he ended up teaching the entire lesson in owlbear form.
在莱希拉姆附近生活的动物中，一直都流传着一位勇猛、正直、深具哲思的“枭熊大人”的传说。传说是什么时候开始流传的呢？大概是赫普探访完莱希拉姆周边地区之后吧……

Among the animals living around the academy, there's a long-standing legend of a brave, righteous, and strangely philosophical figure known as "Lord Owlbear". No one's quite sure when the story began spreading.
赫普对穿衣的要求并不高，只有两条：第一，要足够暖和；第二，要方便变形成枭熊。当然，这两条要求已经将绝大多数衣服排除在外了……
Hepler isn't picky about clothing. He only has two requirements: First, it must be warm. Second, it must allow him to transform easily. Unfortunately, those two requirements rule out most outfits...
“记住，在魔法这条路上，最重要的并非多么强大的力量，或是利用魔法得到多少利益，而是学会热爱魔法、尊重魔法。”——赫普在第一堂课上如此叮嘱新生。
"Remember this: On the path of magic, what matters most is not power, nor what you can gain from magic—but learning to love magic, and to respect it." —Hepler, on the first day of each class
在常人眼中，宫廷魔法师代表着魔法之路的顶峰，是强大魔法师的代表，但赫普却有不同的看法。在他看来，王室的魔法师缺少一种品质：对魔法的敬畏。
To most people, court mages represent the pinnacle of magical achievement. Hepler disagrees. In his view, royal mages are missing one crucial quality: reverence for magic itself.
莱希拉姆的学生来自各个地方，耀光、绿裔、蛮血……谁都能进来！
The Lyceum attracts students of all stripes and colors—Lightbearers, Wilders, Maulers... you name it.
有时候，我饿着路过河边，就会想把爪子伸进水里，把那些诱人的肥鱼拍出水面。
Sometimes, when I pass the river on an empty stomach... I feel the urge to dip my paws in, smack the fattest fish straight out of the water.
加热的饮品？真是惹人心烦。
